STA Scheduled Tasks - Reference

Every published recurring STA / AI-system automation, what it does, and when it runs  ·  Adam Baker  ·  Updated 2026-08-19

INTERNAL · ADMIN REFERENCE

What this is: the catalog of scheduled tasks that keep STA's work products and AI system running - the daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly jobs that fire on their own in Cowork. Seventeen tasks, all Enabled.

Scope: STA work automations and AI-system maintenance only. Personal and one-time tasks are excluded by design and are not described here.

Status pills: Enabled runs on schedule; Disabled exists but is paused.

Daily & weekday

TaskWhenWhat it doesStatus
Morning customer meeting summaryDaily 7:00 AM Mon-FriSlack post to #daily-support-call-summary previewing today's customer meetings.Enabled
WPA standup morningWeekdays 8:00 AMThe light run. Reads the state the 16:30 recap wrote, checks only the delta since then, and captures and displays tasks. It does not redo the heavy pass.Enabled
WPA standup eveningWeekdays 4:30 PMThe heavy run. Moved from 16:00 on 2026-08-19 so that it runs after work-brain-auto-tidy and Part G8 can therefore report.Enabled
Work brain auto tidyDaily 4:00 PMAuto-tidy for the Work Brain only (Projects\STA Projects\Work Assistant\Adam-Work-Brain). Not "both brains" - the scope is one brain by design.Enabled
Daily email summaryWeekdays 4:40 PMSummarises Adam's work inbox into one rolling file per week - each run splices that day's section onto the top of work-email-week-of-{Monday}.html and refreshes a roll-up of open items spanning the week so far. Monday's window covers Friday, Saturday and Sunday, so no weekend mail is lost even though the task does not run then. Read-only - it posts nothing and never sends mail. Filename collision: a separate personal and civic job writes email-summary-week-*.html into the same folder and is out of scope for this reference; never glob that pattern to find this task's output.Enabled

How this list was built

This catalog is built from the Cowork Scheduled Tasks list - the registration surface itself - and every row above corresponds to a task on that list. Seventeen tasks are described above. The list was read from an export dated 2026-08-27 rather than the live Cowork UI, so re-check a row against the live list before relying on it.

Why the source matters. Earlier passes inferred the catalog from task folders on disk. That inference is wrong and it is what produced the previous errors in this document: a folder is an instruction store, not a registration. A folder can exist with no task registered against it, and a registered task can run without a folder of its own - so folder-counting both invented rows that never ran and missed rows that did. Rebuild this file from the Scheduled Tasks list, never from a directory listing.

Personal and one-time tasks are excluded by design. They are out of scope for this reference and are deliberately not enumerated here.

Maintaining these tasksScheduled tasks are Cowork-only. When creating or editing one that touches project files, the folder field must be set to the workspace folder (...\STA Projects\The Architect) - an empty folder field launches the run with nothing mounted and it fails with "files inaccessible." Setting that field is what gives a run its files; it is not what registers the task. Architect-produced recurring outputs are created and updated by The Architect; project-specific tasks are owned by their project's Cowork chat; system-wide jobs by System Monitor.
